cursor.note: PROVED — the instance address is resolved, never spelled, and the corpus is at zero with a gate standing over it in two seats. WHAT THIS VOYAGE ACTUALLY SETTLED: the rule got ONE spelling. cairn/tools/base/address_rule.py is the single definition of a hand-spelled instance address, and it is an AST PREDICATE OVER AN EXPRESSION rather than a text scan — a mention lives in an ast.Constant, a spelling is an ast.BinOp — which is why the old watcher's exclude-my-own-file-by-name is gone rather than re-implemented: the rule's own module is not exempt and is proved not to be. SEAT ONE is build time (build_inspector's address_is_resolved_never_spelled sieve, registered 21st, attributing by deepest owner so a holder never wears its nested machine's finding); SEAT TWO is pulse time (cairn/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_address_gate_bite.py), and the second seat exists because ZERO SITES IS WHAT A WORKING GATE AND A DELETED ONE BOTH PRINT — the probe reads the REGISTRY as well as the count, which no count could have told anyone. MEASURED AT THE CLOSE: 0 hand-spelled sites over 276 files, sieve registered, 3 exemptions each bearing weight at exactly one line. The cast predicted three exemptions and the AST shape retired one of them at PROVEME (274 files, 2 exemptions); the third is back at 3 because the corpus grew two files, which is the exemption set behaving as a RULE closed at two dialects rather than a list of names — the thing test_address_rule.py's tooth pins. THE CHART WAS ANSWERED FIRST (verdict-20260817T190347-ce325abeeed7): 13 criteria run by their instruments, all pass; 11 hypotheses dispositioned, all confirmed. THE WATCH IS ARMED AND READ AT ARMING, n=0 toward a horizon of three non-vacuous zero readings, with the asymmetry the ticket demands: one standing site in a component built after this lands is STRONG falsification and satisfies alone, because a green gate gets leaned on and that is worse than no gate; a vacuous reading (files_read == 0) counts toward neither branch and is itself a red. TWO DEFECTS WERE CAUGHT MID-BUILD BY STANDING PHYSICS AND BOTH ARE FIXED: hand_spelled_instance_paths._enough carried the signature (now, context) while Probe.gathered_enough calls enough(context) — censused across all 30 probes carrying an enough, n=1, and it was the file this ticket owns; and test_probe_carry's corpus tooth redded the new probe on arrival for carrying its ticket as a bare id instead of a path built by owning_ticket(), the 2026-08-05 ruling doing exactly the job it was made physics for. AND THE GROUND LOOP CAUGHT ME: the beat benched the base device on a real ImportError from a window in this build (walk_py not yet exported from cairn.tools.import_sieve); fixed on disk, the daemon restarted because a two-day-old process held the pre-export module, cleared through TroubleDevice.clear, and base is back on the roster. CLEARED ONTO cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_address_rule.py, re-sealed under the tester in the moment before this crossing — because the honest moment to lean on a seal is the moment after it is cut, and this component's fingerprint moves every time its own history is appended to.

window.note: KICK-BACK TO BUILDME — the chart is not answered, so this node does not rest. The code is built and green under a confirmed netns seal and the watch is armed and crossed; what refuses PROVED is the VERDICT, and it refuses honestly. Of the validate berth's eight criteria, three pass (the three rungs proved off-box under injected roots with the real home never read and the temp tree empty after; the teeth shown to GRIP by a seeded hollow resolver, red at the tooth that names the reason; the charter delta with the lab copy identical after the gate was poked in the same act) and five fail. THE FIVE, AND WHAT KIND OF FAILURE EACH IS. (3) The one-table criterion's fourth instrument clause — 'no cairn.* import under cairn/tools/base outside {cairn.tools.base.*, cairn.tools.charter.projector}' — cannot run: deviceness.py reaches cairn.devices.ground_loop.discovery and transitions.py reaches five components, identically at HEAD. That is a FALSE PREMISE INHERITED FROM THE CAST, which asserted the subset from a measure it never ran over the whole package. The three substantive clauses all pass, and stronger than written: counters._ROOTS IS address.ROOTS, object identity rather than equality. (4) Two import allowlists were widened to admit cairn.tools.base.address, each with a dated comment naming this ticket per the corpus precedent — but the criterion says 'with no assertion edited', and a data tuple inside a proof is an assertion's vocabulary. A REAL DEVIATION, reported rather than absorbed. (5) The floor is 2, not 1: build_inspector/inspector.py:216 was censused at cast and dropped at decompose with no gate noticing, and it needs a rung the ladder does not have — a DEVICE ACROSS INSTANCES. (6) The probe's claim predicted that same floor of 1; the mechanism is confirmed in every other respect. (8) Not runnable — its instrument reads the CLOSED ticket and this voyage does not close. WHAT THE KICK-BACK IS ASKING FOR, and why it is not more building on my own authority: three of the five are the CHART being wrong rather than the BUILD, and I did not retune a single criterion — a falsifier edited to match what happened cannot report that anything happened. The remaining work needs bounds only Akien sets: whether the two allowlist widenings stand, and whether the eighth site earns a fourth rung (device-across-instances) or stays hand-spelled with a named disposition. The verdict artifact that states all of this is DRAFTED AND CANNOT BE BERTHED: cairn.machines.chart.verdict has exactly one exit, so a kick-back leaves no durable artifact through that door and this record is the only place it lives. That is itself a finding about the chart chain, and it is the second one this voyage produced — the first being that a piece's file list is prose no gate checks against the survey berth.

The chart changed the shape at CONSTRAIN: the rule is an AST predicate over an EXPRESSION (a Path.home()/'.cairn' BinOp chain; expanduser over a '~/.cairn' literal), not the text scan the probe carries. PROOFS GREEN TWICE UNDER NETNS: build_inspector 3/3 (incl. the new test_address_sieve.py, defect-first with nine teeth because the corpus was converted in the same voyage and the sieve was born green), inference_domain 5/5 (incl. the new tooth that the overlay berths at the resolved instance address), aider_shim 7/7, ground_loop 5/5, tools/base 19/20 — the one red being the pre-existing filed trouble test_watchme_spec.py, which this voyage did not touch. window.note: WATCHME(the_address_gate_bites) — armed at cairn/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_address_gate_bite.py, which is the berth the ticket's spec names, and THIS CROSSING IS THE MEASUREMENT THAT IT IS ARMED: the emission gate resolves the spec's probe path and raises WatchmeEmissionRed on an unarmed one, so a passing crossing is the instrument, not a claim about it. THE PROBE BERTHS WITH WHAT IT WATCHES, NOT WITH THE TICKET IT WAS COMPILED FROM — the thing being watched is the SIEVE REGISTRY, which is build_inspector's, so the probe sits there even though the ticket's component is cairn/tools/base. The corpus half of the same question is read without authority by the resolver's own watch at cairn/tools/base/probes/hand_spelled_instance_paths.py; this one reads BOTH halves. WHY BOTH, and it is the whole design: a count alone cannot tell a working gate from a deleted one — a rule dropped out of build_inspector.SIEVES leaves the corpus reading clean, and 0 sites is what a live gate and an absent gate both print. So the carry names three states that a bare zero collapses: gate_absent (the sieve is not registered), gate_did_not_bite (a site stands while the sieve IS registered — the gate is present and green anyway), and vacuous (files_read == 0, a scan that read nothing, indistinguishable from a clean corpus at the moment the instrument broke). ENOUGH IS DELIBERATELY ASYMMETRIC, per the ticket: ONE hand-spelled site standing in a component built after this ticket lands is STRONG falsification and satisfies alone, because a green gate gets leaned on and that is worse than no gate; THREE consecutive non-vacuous readings at zero, at least one taken after a component that NEEDED instance state was built, is WEAK confirmation and also satisfies. A vacuous reading counts toward neither and is itself a red. READ AT ARMING (n=0 toward the horizon, and recorded so a later reading has a baseline that is not a memory): 0 hand-spelled sites over 276 files, sieve registered, 3 exemptions each bearing weight at exactly one line, would_trigger False, enough False, readings_needed_to_confirm 3, readings_seen 0. The at_proved snapshot the probe carries reads 0 sites over 274 files with 3 exemptions — so the corpus has grown by two files since the PROVED-side measurement and stayed at zero, which is the only kind of clean reading that means anything here.
